name: lending_servicing
summary: Loan repayment schedules, installments, accruals and controlled adjustments
description: Companion for the lending module: versioned repayment schedules with per-installment contractual rows (principal, interest, fees, penalties and paid/balance components), interest accrual records kept separate from contractual interest, and controlled adjustment/rescheduling records. The deterministic schedule data model persists the approved schedule; recalculations happen only through a controlled restructure version, preserving prior versions.
author: Nexa
